title: Create: KineticLink
description: A wireless kinetic transmission system for Create. Power advanced machinery, vehicles, and moving contraptions without physical shaft connections.
body:
![Cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd3331eaca6f8188ba930923ba8d54e713d7f972.png) 

## Kinetic Link

Kinetic Link is a Create addon for 1.20.1 fabric minecraft version that enables wireless transmission of rotational power between separate mechanical systems, removing the need for physical shaft connections across long distances or complex structures.

Designed to expand the engineering possibilities of Create, Kinetic Link allows players to transfer RPM from one kinetic network to another using configurable transmitters and receivers. This makes it possible to power mechanisms in locations where traditional mechanical connections are impractical or impossible.

The mod is especially useful when combined with Clockwork and Valkyrien Skies, allowing rotational power to be delivered inside moving structures, vehicles, and advanced mechanical systems without relying on Creative Motors.

## Features
- Wireless RPM transmission
- Configurable transmission channels
- Integration with Create's kinetic network system
- Supports advanced engineering projects
- Ideal for moving contraptions and complex machinery
- Survival-friendly alternative to Creative Motors
- Designed with compatibility for Clockwork-based creations in mind

## Use Cases
- Distributed industrial machinery
- Advanced automation systems
- Large-scale engineering projects
- Moving vehicles and structures
- Multi-axis rotational mechanisms
- Complex kinetic contraptions
- Custom mechanical creations

## Dependencies

Required:

1. Create Fabric: create-fabric-6.0.8.1+build.1744-mc1.20.1.jar
2. Create: New Age: create_new-age-1.1.7f+fabric-mc1.20.1.jar
3. Fabric API: 0.92.7+1.20.1

## About

Kinetic Link was created to overcome the limitations of traditional shaft-based power transmission in Create, making it possible to build more sophisticated kinetic systems while preserving the survival gameplay experience.

## Current Status

This is the first public release and is considered an early version. Feedback, bug reports and suggestions are welcome.

## Planned Features

* Improved stress handling
* Better synchronization
* Visual indicators and animations
* Advanced channel management
* Full integration with moving structures and ships

Built for Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric.
